label: Camera lens
description: Lens effects, perspective, focus, bokeh, optical character, and motion rendering in photographs.
notes: Visible optical effects and shutter treatments belong here, named without focal-length or aperture recipes. camera.shot_size owns framing, camera.angle owns viewpoint, and camera.film_look owns capture media and photographic processes. Perspective descriptions assume the camera is moved to maintain similar subject framing. Values are short noun phrases after “shot with”; filters and motion treatments are included for their distinct visible effects.

values.look: A broad view with nearby objects enlarged and more space opening behind them.
A moderate view with natural-looking proportions and little obvious stretching.
A narrow portrait view with gently flattened facial proportions and a softly separated background.

values.text: a telephoto lens with strong compression
values.look: Distant layers appear crowded together, with large background features behind the subject.
An expansive view with straight lines preserved, dramatic foreground scale, and stretched objects near the edges.
A distant subject fills a very narrow view against an enlarged, strongly flattened background.
Tiny subjects fill the image, revealing surface textures and details normally too small to see.

values.text: shallow depth of field and creamy bokeh
values.look: The subject stays sharp while the background dissolves into smooth, soft patches of color.
Foreground, middle distance, and background remain sharp enough to read together.
A near object and a distant subject are both sharp, sometimes separated by a soft seam.
One small off-center area stays sharp while the surrounding image stretches into blur.
A narrow band of sharpness between blurred foreground and background makes a real scene look toy-sized.
Tall structures keep parallel vertical edges rather than appearing to lean inward at the top.
An extremely wide rectangular image with straight lines bowing outward around the center.
A round image floats inside black corners, with extreme curved perspective around its rim.

values.text: an anamorphic widescreen lens with oval bokeh and horizontal flares
values.look: A wide cinematic view with vertically oval blurred lights and horizontal streaks across bright sources.
Repeated fragments of the subject form mirrored wedges around a central image.
Small bright lights sprout crisp radiating spikes while the rest of the image stays relatively sharp.
A tiny subject looms in the foreground while a wide view reveals its surrounding environment.
Moving subjects smear into trails while stationary objects remain clear.
A moving subject stays relatively sharp against a background streaked sideways.

values.text: a fast shutter speed freezing motion
values.look: Fast movement stops crisply, with individual droplets, flying debris, or airborne limbs sharply defined.
Lines of blur radiate from the center as though the scene is rushing toward the viewer.
The whole scene becomes sweeping streaks of color, with stationary objects blurred along the same path.

values.text: a Petzval lens with swirl bokeh
values.look: A sharp center is surrounded by blurred highlights that curve into a circular swirl.
Fine details soften and bright areas spread into a gentle glow without becoming uniform defocus.
The scene has soft detail across a deep range of distances, dim corners, and gently smeared moving objects.

values.text: a mirror telephoto lens with donut bokeh
values.look: Out-of-focus highlights form bright rings with dark centers behind a compressed distant subject.

values.text: a vintage lens with strong flare
values.look: Bright light washes out contrast and creates colored ghost shapes across the image.
